Before I moved to TX I had the luxury of having a community that would be able to step in and take care of my dog whenever I had to be away for travel. I was worried I wouldn't be able to find people I could trust to do the same here. After a bad stint using the Rover app, I did research on Doggy Daycares in Oak Cliff.

I'm glad I found Bones & Bacon! I appreciate that they require a day to see if my dog, Billy, would be a fit for them and vice versa. (Let's be real, not all dogs are meant to be in doggy daycare with other dogs and as a pet owner, you should take responsibility and ownership of that.) Billy passed with flying colors and the rest is history. He is always so excited when he knows we're getting close to daycare. He could care less about me when I drop him off. Special shout out to Christian because he's so thorough and attentive. One day he even noticed that it looked like Billy might have an ear infection. I already knew that he did but it made me feel better knowing that staff pays attention. Another thing I appreciate is that pricing is pretty fair, especially compared to other daycares I've seen.

My only wish is that they had live cameras so that I could see my dog when I'm away.
I love Bones and Bacon and they take such excellent care of my babies and are so very kind to me. Anytime my doggos stay there they come home happy
Amazing staff! I always feel good leaving my dog in their care. She loves Bones and Bacon.
First two days at this doggy daycare and my pup is so tired when he comes back!

My dogs love coming to Bones and Bacon for daycare!! They get excited and are tired after a long day. I have boarded both my girls here and have no complaints. They send updated/photos and I see how happy they are being there. They also get excited seeing the staff.

I love Bones And Bacon so much. I brought my dog in today and they did a temperament test to make sure that my dog got along with the other dogs and they said it went well and And they are amazing the shift leader Sharon was a phenomenal phenomenal person. She was nice, friendly kind, and I just know that my baby dog will be safe and loved by all the staff. Can’t wait to bring him back.
They have the best staff! My boy comes home happy and tired. He has been going since he was a puppy, his favorite time of the week.
They take good care of my dog, and my dog seems to enjoy. I like it when they post him on their social media!
My dog and I love bones and bacon. I feel safe knowing my dog is in good hands and enjoying himself while I am at work. Leigh Anne and crew are excellent care givers.

Love Bones & Bacon!! My dog’s been going there for a couple years. She’s always super excited to see everyone when she gets there and she is worn out when I pick her up! As I type this she’s already put herself to bed! Bonus: a lot of my fav pics of my dog were taken by the team there.
